title: Protected execution foundation
objective: Create the internal process execution contract and fail-closed workspace/environment validation required before any process or PowerShell capability may be exposed through MCP.

authority_delta.process: No new MCP process authority; internal planning/validation only
authority_delta.secrets: Defines non-inheritance contract; no secret access

invariants: process.spawn remains denied by policy and absent from the MCP tool surface
PowerShell remains absent from the MCP tool surface
execution cwd must resolve inside the selected workspace
executable must be an absolute existing file for this foundation
secret-like environment variables and Cotra/tunnel authority variables are not propagated
execution limits are explicit and bounded
Job Objects are treated as lifecycle controls, not a security sandbox
Windows AppContainer/restricted-token containment must be proven before arbitrary execution authority is enabled

acceptance.claim: ExecutionPlan validation is deterministic and fail-closed.
Out-of-workspace cwd and relative/non-file executables are rejected.
Secret-like and Cotra authority environment variables are stripped.
process.spawn and PowerShell remain policy-denied and unregistered in MCP.
Windows and Ubuntu exact-head CI pass.

done_when: The internal execution contract is qualified and merged without exposing execution authority. The next grain may implement Windows containment against this contract.
